overview: The Kronenwetter Parks Committee approved a $5,000 local match to accept a Wausau & Marathon County Parks & Recreation Foundation Fund grant, and voted 7-0 to bring the September 12, 2026 Buska Park 5K Run/Walk Fundraiser to the Village Board as an official Village event. A motion to draw up to $2,000 from community events funds for an August 21 concert fundraiser at Towering Pines failed 1-6, with only Tikalsky voting in favor. Public Works Director Greg Ulman was directed to compile a prioritized list of park improvement projects and costs following the committee's recent multi-park tour.
presiding: Trustee Aaron Myszka (called meeting to order)

discussions.item: Approval of June 29, 2026 Parks Committee Meeting Minutes
discussions.body: Tikalsky moved and Vedvik seconded approval of the June 29, 2026 minutes. The motion carried by voice vote 7-0.
Public Works Director Greg Ulman provided an update on park grants and discussed the possibility of integrating donor-name bricks into the Buska Park renovation. No action was taken on this item.

discussions.item: Wausau & Marathon County Parks & Recreation Foundation Fund Grant
discussions.body: Public Works Director Ulman presented information on a grant awarded to the Village and answered budgetary questions from committee members. Tikalsky moved and Myszka seconded a motion to accept a $5,000 local match to the grant. The motion carried by roll call vote 7-0.

Committee members discussed observations from their recent tour of Municipal Park, Towering Pines Park, Buska Park, Friendship Park, and Seville Park. Potential improvements discussed included public restrooms, bench and table additions, shelters, playground equipment updates, ADA compliance, walking paths, community gardens, a skate park, and little libraries. Public Works Director Ulman was directed to compile a list of park improvements and associated costs to present at a future meeting.

discussions.item: August 21, 2026 Concert at Towering Pine Fundraiser Event
discussions.body: The committee discussed potential event details including t-shirts, a musician, routes, entry costs, sponsors, and staff involvement. Tikalsky moved and Lesniak seconded a motion to request up to $2,000 from community events funds to support a fundraiser event. The motion failed by roll call vote 1-6, with only Tikalsky voting in favor.

discussions.item: September 12, 2026 Buska Park 5K Run/Walk Fundraiser Event
discussions.body: The committee discussed event details including sponsors, family attractions, food, donation opportunities, costs, and a musical group. Vedvik moved and Holewinski seconded a motion to request the Village Board approve the 5K Run/Walk as an official Village event. The motion carried by roll call vote 7-0.

discussions.item: Creating a 'Friends of the Kronenwetter Parks' Support Group
discussions.body: No action was taken on this item; it was deferred to the next Parks Committee meeting for discussion.

actionItems: Village to accept $5,000 local match for the Wausau & Marathon County Parks & Recreation Foundation Fund grant.
Public Works Director Greg Ulman directed to create and present a list of park improvements and their estimated costs based on the committee's parks tour observations.
Request submitted to Village Board to approve the September 12, 2026 Buska Park 5K Run/Walk as an official Village event.
'Friends of the Kronenwetter Parks' support group discussion deferred to the next meeting.

Future agenda items to include possible dog park at Norm Plaza Park, possible disc golf course at the Wellhead land, water access point at Gardner Park or Nelson Roads, bench placement along walking trails, 5K event specifics, and discussion of future Village events.
